own_solution.law: Photoelectric current I = eta * e * P / (h c / lambda)
assumptions: each photon has energy hc/lambda = 3.1 eV

T9477.regime: work function below the photon energy hc/lambda = 3.1 eV (above threshold); above it no electrons would be emitted

TEBFE.regime: work function below the photon energy hc/lambda = 3.1 eV (above threshold); above it no electrons would be emitted

notes: E = 1240/400 = 3.1 eV; photon rate = 5e-3 / (3.1 * 1.602e-19) = 1.0068e16 /s; I = 0.003 * 1.0068e16 * 1.602e-19 = 4.8387e-6 A (e cancels: I = eta P / 3.1 V). With 8.4 mW: 8.1290e-6 A. Work function 1.9 eV is below the photon energy, so with the stated yield it does not change the current (K); the electrons' kinetic energy would depend on it but not the current with full collection. Wall chart and earlier-measurement sentences have no path (D).
